updates.headline: v0.1.44 — Offline Story Explore Pacing
updates.summary: Offline Story's opening Explore advances through six authored 10-enemy batches when two or fewer enemies from the current batch remain. The HUD now shows only EXPLORE.

categories.name: Story
changes: Opening Explore advances to the next authored region after its 10-enemy batch is issued and no more than two members of that batch remain alive.
Earlier Explore enemies can remain alive without affecting the active batch's progress.
The Explore HUD no longer shows a kill counter.

updates.headline: v0.1.40 — Offline Story Core Defense Population
updates.summary: Offline Story Core defenses now run to 100 legitimate kills and refill more quickly as active enemies fall, while keeping the 10-enemy cap.

categories.name: Story
changes: Offline Story Core defense now requires 100 legitimate kills.
Defense spawns refill faster as the active enemy population drops, with a 10-enemy cap and the selected Core's authored spawn region preserved.

updates.headline: v0.1.39 — Offline Story Explore Route and Core Travel
updates.summary: The opening Explore follows six authored regions, Core travel uses walkable path distance, and the current Core and player-start placements are synchronized.

categories.name: Story
changes: The opening Explore follows six authored regions, moving new enemy spawns after every 10 legitimate kills.
Core travel time follows the walkable route to the selected Core and saves its remaining countdown.
Core placements use the current authored unit scale and ground height.
Fixed player startup to use the exact authored PlayerSpawn marker.

updates.headline: v0.1.38 — Offline Story Core Travel and Spawn Fixes
updates.summary: Core travel now preserves DPS passive timing, defense enemies follow the selected Core's spawn region, and Archive Cores appear at their intended size and placement.

categories.name: Story
changes: DPS passive timing now pauses during Core travel and resumes when defense begins.
Core defense enemies now spawn from the selected Core's authored region volumes.
Archive Cores now use the intended size and exact authored marker placement.

updates.headline: v0.1.37 — Offline Story Spawn Regions
updates.summary: Offline Story enemies and Healer Hearts now use the authored spawn areas for each Core location, with improved Boss arena add placement.

categories.name: Story
changes: Explore and Core defense enemies now spawn from authored region volumes, with separate spawn groups for each Blue and Green Core location.
Healer Hearts now appear within the authored Heart areas for the active Story region.

categories.name: Boss
changes: Boss1 begins with a small protective pack; later adds enter from the full Blue spawn pool and can pass through the arena blockers while players and Boss1 remain contained.
